title: Enterprise Support: Retained account funding for retained-fee cash return
content:
Enterprise Support — Retained account funding for retained-fee cash return.

## Decision basis

For retained-fee cash return: When the customer elects to retain one corrected source-month support fee as account funding, subtract that corrected fee from the magnitude of the negative current receivable, then floor the refundable surplus at zero; this is a customer funding choice and not an additional charge.

## Hypothetical case

For retained-fee cash return: Suppose a hypothetical negative current receivable has magnitude USD 300 and the customer elects to retain a corrected monthly fee of USD 90. The surplus after retained funding is USD 210. With only USD 60 of surplus and the same hypothetical fee, it is zero. Retaining funding does not create a charge.
